meta.name: compare-biosamples
meta.description: Compare ENCODE experiments across different biosamples, tissues, or cell lines to identify tissue-specific regulatory patterns. Use when the user wants cross-tissue comparison, cell-type comparison, tissue-specific elements, differential chromatin, biosample matching, disease vs normal comparison, developmental time course, constitutive vs variable regulation, or multi-tissue data availability mapping. Handles batch effect detection, biosample hierarchy, and comparison design.

copy.tagline: 比较不同生物样本的调控模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在ENCODE实验中比较不同生物样本的调控特征。
copy.tagline_en: Compare regulatory patterns across different biosamples
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to compare regulatory features across biosamples in ENCODE experiments.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你比较不同组织、细胞系等生物样本的 ENCODE 实验数据，找出组织特异的调控模式。
howto.when: 当你询问跨组织比较、细胞类型差异、组织特异增强子等话题时触发。

say.text: 比较肝脏和胰腺的 H3K27ac 信号。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并匹配两个组织的相关实验数据。

say.text: 哪些调控元件在所有组织中都有活性？
say.note: Claude 会分析组成性调控元件。

say.text: 帮我看看大脑和小脑的 ATAC-seq 数据可用性。
say.note: Claude 会构建数据可用性矩阵。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you compare ENCODE experiments across different biosamples, tissues, or cell lines to identify tissue-specific regulatory patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about cross-tissue comparison, cell-type differences, tissue-specific enhancers, or similar topics.

say_en.text: Compare H3K27ac between liver and pancreas.
say_en.note: Claude will search and match relevant experiments.

say_en.text: Which regulatory elements are active in all tissues?
Check ATAC-seq data availability for brain and cerebellum.
say_en.note: Claude will build an availability matrix.
